callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a string path to a project directory
callees.post_condition: Returns an initialized CodeGraphExtractor instance when CodeGraph is available and can index the project directory; returns None when CodeGraph is unavailable or cannot be initialized for the project, signaling the caller that CodeGraph-based extraction is not possible

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_function_spans
callees.signature: get_function_spans(self, language: str, filepath: str) -> list | None
callees.pre_condition: self is an initialized CodeGraphExtractor instance; language is a string language key; filepath is a string path to a source file
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of (name, start_idx, end_idx) triples — one per function definition in the file for the given language — where name is the function's identifier string, start_idx is the 0-indexed inclusive line number of the function body's first line, and end_idx is the 0-indexed inclusive line number of the function body's last line. Returns None when the file is not indexed by CodeGraph
